errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book is requested by book_id but no book with that ID exists in the database.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a member is requested by member_id but no member with that ID exists in the database.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a loan is requested by loan_id but no loan with that ID exists in the database.

errors.name: BookAlreadyBorrowedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to loan a book that is already currently borrowed by another member.

errors.name: MemberNotEligibleForLoanError
errors.description: Raised when a member is not eligible to borrow a book, for example, if their membership status is inactive.
